facts.text: Visible & Infrared Spectrometer (VIR) was deployed at Ceres & Vesta — Perpetual Orbit during Dawn in 2007.
Imaging spectrometer provided by the Italian Space Agency (ASI) covering 0.25 to 5.0 micrometers to map surface mineralogy.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Identified ammoniated phyllosilicates across Ceres, proving Ceres originated in the outer Solar System before migrating inwards.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Ceres & Vesta — Perpetual Orbit.
Confirmed the chemical fingerprint of dwarf planets and their connections to Kuiper Belt objects.
